11:class Provider(BaseProvider):

13:
14:    .. important::
15:       The default locale of the lorem provider is ``la``. When using a locale
16:       without a localized lorem provider, the ``la`` lorem provider will be

18:       the standard provider docs was ``en_US``, and ``en_US`` has a localized
19:       lorem provider which is why the samples here show words in American
20:       English.
21:    """
22:
23:    word_connector = " "
24:    sentence_punctuation = "."
25:
26:    def get_words_list(
27:        self,
28:        part_of_speech: Optional[str] = None,
29:        ext_word_list: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
30:    ) -> List[str]:
31:        """Get list of words.
32:
33:        ``ext_word_list`` is a parameter that allows the user to provide a list
34:        of words to be used instead of the built-in word list. If ``ext_word_list``
35:        is provided, then the value of ``part_of_speech`` is ignored.
36:
37:        ``part_of_speech`` is a parameter that defines to what part of speech
38:        the returned word belongs. If ``ext_word_list`` is not ``None``, then
39:        ``part_of_speech`` is ignored. If the value of ``part_of_speech`` does
40:        not correspond to an existent part of speech according to the set locale,
41:        then an exception is raised.
42:
43:        :sample: part_of_speech="abc", ext_word_list=['abc', 'def', 'ghi', 'jkl']
44:        :sample: part_of_speech="abc"
45:        :sample: ext_word_list=['abc', 'def', 'ghi', 'jkl']
46:
47:        .. warning::
48:            Depending on the length of a locale provider's built-in word list or
49:            on the length of ``ext_word_list`` if provided, a large ``nb`` can
50:            exhaust said lists if ``unique`` is ``True``, raising an exception.
51:        """
52:
53:        if ext_word_list is not None:
54:            word_list = ext_word_list
55:        elif part_of_speech:
56:            if part_of_speech not in self.parts_of_speech:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
57:                raise ValueError(f"{part_of_speech} is not recognized as a part of speech.")
58:            else:
59:                word_list = self.parts_of_speech[part_of_speech]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
60:        else:
61:            word_list = self.word_list  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
62:
63:        return list(word_list)
64:
65:    def words(
66:        self,
67:        nb: int = 3,
68:        ext_word_list: Optional[List[str]] = None,
69:        part_of_speech: Optional[str] = None,
70:        unique: bool = False,
71:    ) -> List[str]:
72:        """Generate a tuple of words.
73:
74:        The ``nb`` argument controls the number of words in the resulting list,
75:        and if ``ext_word_list`` is provided, words from that list will be used
76:        instead of those from the locale provider's built-in word list.
77:
78:        if ``word_list`` is not provided, the method will use a default value of None,
79:        which will result in the method calling the ``get_words_list`` method to get the
80:        word list. If ``word_list`` is provided, the method will use the provided list.
81:
82:        If ``unique`` is ``True``, this method will return a list containing
83:        unique words. Under the hood, |random_sample| will be used for sampling
84:        without replacement. If ``unique`` is ``False``, |random_choices| is
85:        used instead, and the list returned may contain duplicates.
86:
87:        :sample:
88:        :sample: nb=5
89:        :sample: nb=5, ext_word_list=['abc', 'def', 'ghi', 'jkl']
90:        :sample: nb=4, ext_word_list=['abc', 'def', 'ghi', 'jkl'], unique=True
91:        """

93:        word_list = self.get_words_list(part_of_speech=part_of_speech, ext_word_list=ext_word_list)
94:
95:        if unique:
96:            unique_samples = cast(List[str], self.random_sample(word_list, length=nb))
97:            return unique_samples
98:        samples = cast(List[str], self.random_choices(word_list, length=nb))
99:        return samples
100:
101:    def word(self, part_of_speech: Optional[str] = None, ext_word_list: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> str:
102:        """Generate a word.
103:
104:        This method uses |words| under the hood with the ``nb`` argument set to
105:        ``1`` to generate the result.
106:
107:        :sample:

112:        return self.words(1, word_list)[0]

119:        The ``nb_words`` argument controls how many words the sentence will

123:
124:        Under the hood, |words| is used to generate the words, so the argument
125:        ``ext_word_list`` works in the same way here as it would in that method.
126:
127:        :sample: nb_words=10
128:        :sample: nb_words=10, variable_nb_words=False

135:
136:        if variable_nb_words:

139:        word_list = self.get_words_list(ext_word_list=ext_word_list)

145:    def sentences(self, nb: int = 3, ext_word_list: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> List[str]:
146:        """Generate a list of sentences.

148:        This method uses |sentence| under the hood to generate sentences, and

191:        """Generate a list of paragraphs.

193:        This method uses |paragraph| under the hood to generate paragraphs, and

206:        The ``max_nb_chars`` argument controls the approximate number of

212:        :sample: max_nb_chars=20
213:        :sample: max_nb_chars=80
214:        :sample: max_nb_chars=160
215:        :sample: ext_word_list=['abc', 'def', 'ghi', 'jkl']

217:        text: List[str] = []
